shared_elements: arched or hooked form with a base (handled-object-like shape)
row of large rounded/loaf-shaped forms along the upper zone
curved snake- or spiral-like sinuous element
raised outlines with flat interior surfaces
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow-to-medium relief in which profile animals and beaked heads are set beneath an upper zone occupied by a row of large arched, rounded forms with flat bases, an unusually specific correspondence, and both add a curled or serpentine element at lower right/centre. The biggest difference is organisation: B is strictly divided into stacked horizontal registers separated by a patterned band on a flat rectangular slab, whereas A's motifs sprawl over an irregular, heavily eroded boulder surface in far bolder, more rounded high relief.
